captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a multi-part quick-clip handle set designed to attach to cylindrical beverage cans. It includes a long, flat back handle piece with notched ends, a smaller central V-shaped gripping adapter, and a separate slide-on clip mechanism with cylindrical cutouts. The components feature flat, rectangular profiles with precise circular cutouts and interlocking tabs to securely snap onto standard can rims.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, 3D-printable can handle assembly in OpenSCAD. The model should include an adjustable main handle body, a customizable grip section with optional curved text, and top and bottom clips designed to snap onto standard beverage cans, with parameters for can height, can diameter, handle thickness, and custom text.
captions.factory: The design uses boolean difference and intersection operations on cubes and cylinders to form the primary structures. The main handle body is created by intersecting a rectangular cube with a large cylinder subtraction to form a comfortable curved grip. The top and bottom clip assemblies are constructed using cubes combined with rotated cylinders to create the circular clamping surfaces tailored to the can diameter parameter. Optional text is wrapped along a circular path using an external 'writecircle' module, with conditional rendering based on user choices for text height, boldness, and raised/embossed style.
